operating_notes.text: APE product mix FY26 was Par 7%, Non-Par 33% and ULIP 60%, against 3/33/64 in FY25.
APE channel mix FY26 was bancassurance 60%, agency 29% and others 11%.
94% of debt investments were in AAA and Sovereign instruments, with a debt-equity mix of 62:38.
Bihar GST appellate authority confirmed a FY2021-22 demand of ₹6,19,497 tax, ₹3,80,989 interest and ₹64,697 penalty; company to appeal to the Appellate Tribunal.
13th-month persistency for regular premium policies rose to 87.94% in FY26 from 87.41% in FY25; 25th-month persistency improved to 78.0% from 77.7%.
Renewal premium collections were ₹58,734.8 Cr in FY26, up 18.9% YoY, with 1.34 lakh lapsed policies revived generating ₹888 Cr.
Bancassurance contributed 49.88% of total business in FY26; AUM grew 8.73% to ₹4,871.63 billion.
Q1FY27 13th-month persistency was 84.35% on premium basis, down from 87.94% in FY26.

Sahara India Life portfolio: SAT dismissed SILIC's appeal on 5 December 2025; SBI Life will maintain separate books for SILIC during FY2026-27, with the closing balance as at 31 March 2027 reflected in its financials.
IRDAI granted a one-year forbearance from Ind AS adoption for FY2026-27; results are prepared under Indian GAAP.
Q1FY27: 13th and 49th month persistency at 87.7% and 69.1%, up 61 and 68 bps YoY; 61st month dipped as the COVID cohort reached that bucket.
Q1FY27: bancassurance (SBI and RRBs) contributed 47% of total APE; other channels grew 160% and contributed 28% of APE.
Q1FY27: AUM ₹5.2 trillion, up 10%; embedded value ₹852.9 bn, up 15%; 4.25 lakh new policies covering 8.7 million lives.
GST demand of ₹1,12,99,508 (tax ₹96,12,911, interest ₹7,25,306, penalty ₹9,61,291) for excess ITC claimed in GSTR-3B vs GSTR-2B for April–August 2025; under appeal.

watchlist.response: Confirmed the 60 bps was entirely GTI but declined to quantify product-wise margins, saying it does not disclose those numbers.
watchlist.text: Analysts asked how much of the 60 bps product-mix margin drag came from the one-off group term (GTI) contract versus individual business.

watchlist.response: Said some impact remains in Q2FY27 (GST waived from 22 September) and should fade thereafter, with product mix offsetting it.
watchlist.text: GST drag of about 110 bps persisted for a third quarter; analysts asked whether it continues.

watchlist.response: Attributed it to stamp duty on higher sum assured and first-quarter labour-code costs; said it will continue in tandem with sum assured.
watchlist.text: Other expenses rose even after adjusting for GST.

watchlist.response: Said the shift from ROP to pure protection (41% growth) carries lower ticket sizes, so APE growth understates volume.
watchlist.text: Individual protection APE growth of about 15-19% looked softer than peers.

watchlist.response: Evasive: said the number was not available and would be shared separately.
